#[test]
fn builds_and_runs() {
    let bin = e2e_support::cargo_bin!("ipe");
    let target = e2e_support::target::shared().unwrap().unwrap();
    let mut cmd = e2e_support::target::ipe_command(
        &bin.into_path_buf(),
        &e2e_support::target::BuildTarget::Shared(target),
    );
    let out = cmd.args(["run"]).output().unwrap();
    assert!(out.status.success());
}
